name: Pfizer Ltd
about: Pfizer Ltd is engaged in manufacturing, marketing, trading and export of pharmaceutical products. It manufactures products through its own facility and also has various independent contract/ third party manufacturers based across the country and sells its products through independent distributors primarily in India. [1] It is the 3rd largest multinational pharmaceutical company in India. [2]
key_points: Parentage The company is a subsidiary of Pfizer Inc. one of the world’s leading biopharma companies with a presence in over 125 countries. Pfizer develops and produces medicines and vaccines for immunology, oncology, cardiology, endocrinology, and neurology. [1] [2]

profile.summary: Pfizer Limited engages in manufacturing, marketing, trading, and distribution of pharmaceutical products in India and internationally. It offers therapy area and products, such as vaccines, injectables and anti-infectives, inflammation and immunology, and internal medicine for cardiovascular care, oncology, respiratory, multivitamins and multimineral, neuroscience, women's health, gastroenterology, pain management, and nutrition, addressing. The company also offers anti-infectives services to hospitals and nursing homes. It sells its products through a network of independent distributors. Pfizer Limited was incorporated in 1950 and is based in Mumbai, India.
